of.needed: whether existing ImagePolicy objects are still stored as v1beta2 (CRD status.storedVersions includes v1beta2)

consequence.statement: Existing ImagePolicy objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; a storage version migration and an update of status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImagePolicy objects so they are stored as v1, then remove v1beta2 from the imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD's status.storedVersions.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1. Existing ImagePolicy objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten, so they need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta2.
